definitions.gloss: excellent work; outstanding piece; prize-winning entry
definitions.explanation: A work of particularly high quality, especially one that receives recognition in a competition or exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: His work was selected as an outstanding piece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三点|さんてん}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Three outstanding works were announced at this year's contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{審査員|しんさいん}→審査員：28227_shinsain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選出|せんしゅつ}→選出：14448_senshutsu⟧し、⟦{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}→受賞者：24174_jushousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{贈|おく}られる→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The judges select outstanding works from entries gathered from across the country, and prize money is awarded to the winners.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧ (excellent, outstanding) and ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, piece). Commonly used in the context of literary, art, film, and other creative competitions where works are evaluated and ranked.

Often the tier below the grand prize ({最優秀作|さいゆうしゅうさく} or ⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧), making it roughly equivalent to a runner-up or merit award.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be selected as an outstanding work
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}{品|ひん}: outstanding work (with the more formal ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ suffix)
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce the outstanding works

RELATED WORDS:
- {最優秀作|さいゆうしゅうさく}: best work; grand prize winner
- ⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧: grand prize
- ⟦{佳作|かさく}→佳作：22658_kasaku⟧: honorable mention
- {入選作|にゅうせんさく}: selected work; shortlisted entry
